articles.summary: The Security Council met Monday morning with prospects for peace in the Middle East under strain on two fronts. articles.title: World leaders take stock of global fight against racism
articles.summary: World leaders are meeting in the General Assembly to assess how far the world has come in combating racism and how far it still has to go.
